post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As Merlin, I feel that I could have done a better job of keeping a pulse on the FAIL count for each mission and made adjustments accordingly, but despite this, the team was unable to succeed. The team's downfall came down to two key failures, one which could have been avoided if I had kept closer tabs on the FAIL count. Improving my timing and decision-making on mission turns is crucial.

player_observations.Bob (Assassin): As our team's designated Assassin, Bob played a solid game of hiding in the shadows and picking off targets when opportunities arose. However, I couldn't shake the feeling that Bob was being somewhat overly cautious and failed to contribute significantly to any of our successful missions, suggesting that he may have been holding back too much from the get-go.
player_observations.Charlie (Good Guy): Charlie played a surprisingly consistent role within our team, providing some much-needed support during the early missions. Unfortunately, he couldn't quite scale up to the level of impact required to change the trajectory of our mission losses. It's possible that Charlie would have benefited from more experience with the mechanics to elevate his gameplay.
player_observations.Diana (Good Guy): Diana displayed a knack for taking charge during missions and stepping up when necessary to drive them forward, especially on Mission 1 and Mission 3. Unfortunately, she struggled to find her footing in other situations. Her inconsistent performance could have benefited from a more solid understanding of how to best utilize her role within the game's mechanics.
player_observations.Eve (Evil Leader): As our adversary's leader, Eve was incredibly calculated and cunning. She effectively manipulated the FAIL count within our team's missions and capitalized on the momentum of our losses to deliver crushing blows. Her playstyle demonstrated a deep understanding of the dynamics involved in Avalon, showcasing the importance of adaptability and situational awareness.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I managed to deceive the team by maintaining a consistent good player persona while secretly carrying out the actions of the assassin. However, I sometimes struggled to time my betrayals correctly, which could have led to my downfall if not for the other evil players' performance. Overall, my strategic decision-making could have been more refined.

player_observations.Alice: I was impressed by Alice's ability to maintain a strong Merlin persona, often making well-timed accusations and influencing key decisions. Her subtlety and strategic thinking allowed her to stay under the radar.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's decision-making was quite straightforward and didn't give away his position as a good player until later in the game. However, he struggled to keep up with the pace and was sometimes outmaneuvered by the evil players.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's playstyle was quite inconsistent, often making reckless accusations and struggling to read the situation effectively. However, her occasional flashes of strategic thinking did help to keep the game balanced.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played a solid role as the original evil leader, setting the tone for the team's early success. Her ability to make informed decisions and anticipate the other players' moves helped to keep the game in the evil players' favor.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment:
I could improve on building closer relationships with other players to increase my trust threshold for suggesting missions, as I relied heavily on trusting the leader or another good player, potentially missing out on opportunities to contribute to more missions.
